description.zh:
集合名。

> 您可以通过[ListCollections](~~2401503~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
Collection name.

> You can use the [ListCollections](~~2401503~~) API to view the list.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) API to view details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

description.zh: 要更新的数据的过滤条件，格式为SQL的WHERE格式。此字段不能和Ids字段同时为空。
description.en: Filter condition for the data to be updated, in SQL WHERE format. This field cannot be empty at the same time as the Ids field.

description.zh: 要更新的数据的Id列表，即上传数据时指定的Row.Id。此字段不能和Filter字段同时为空。
description.en: ID list of the data to be updated, i.e., the Row.Id specified when uploading the data. This field cannot be empty at the same time as the Filter field.

description.zh: 需要更新的数据，为MAP格式的JSON字符串。其中key是字段名，value是新的数据取值。
description.en: Data to be updated, in a JSON string of MAP format. The key is the field name, and the value is the new data value.

description.zh:
命名空间。

> 您可以通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
Namespace.

> You can use the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) API to view the list.
Region ID where the instance is located.

description.zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准。
description.en: ID of the Workspace composed of multiple database instances. This parameter and the DBInstanceId parameter cannot both be empty. When both are specified, this parameter takes precedence.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb update-collection-data-metadata --db-instance-id gp-j788ghhjjxxxx --namespace mynamespace --collection document --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace-password testpassword --filter business_value_=_chat_file_1 --ids AC-2642a8744eba4c5eb7d7595d08306d15 --metadata title=new_title content=new_content --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb UpdateCollectionDataMetadata --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-j788ghhjjxxxx' --Filter 'business_value_=_chat_file_1' --Metadata '{"title":"new_title","content":"new_content"}' --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Collection document --Ids '["AC-2642a8744eba4c5eb7d7595d08306d15"]' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace
